faq.hero.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.hero.subtitle: The most common questions before requesting a quote. If you can't find yours, ask directly on WhatsApp.
faq.q1.a: A free first technical visit, at your home or business. From there you get a fixed quote with three options — Essential, Smart and Complete — for you to choose, with no obligation and no small print.
faq.q2.q: What is the Central AI Mini-PC and why is it mandatory?
faq.q2.a: It's the brain behind every mode of the Predictive AI Platform: it analyzes your cameras and sensors and coordinates the whole system. It's mandatory because standalone modes with their own hardware are no longer installed — they all share this same brain. There are two tiers: AI START (€590, for 1-2 modes) and AI PRO (€950, for 3 or more modes, or AI Security with several cameras at once).
faq.q3.q: Do I have to pay a monthly fee?
faq.q3.a: No. All the analysis happens locally, on your own mini-PC, without relying on an external server or an alarm monitoring center. You pay for the installation once and the system is yours, with no fees afterward.
faq.q4.q: How does AI Security avoid false alarms?
faq.q4.a: The system doesn't just record: it analyzes each camera with AI and learns to tell real people and vehicles apart from false alarms — a cat, a shadow, a bag moving in the wind. It only alerts you on WhatsApp, with a photo, when it really matters.
faq.q5.q: What areas do you work in?
faq.q6.q: How long does an installation take?
faq.q6.a: It depends on the service: from a quick couple-hour job (a lock, a few outlets) to a full day for larger installations. The exact time is confirmed during the technical visit.
faq.q7.q: What warranty do the installations have?
faq.q7.a: Every AHOMED installation comes with a warranty, using materials from leading brands, and the equipment is yours from day one.
faq.q8.q: Can I start with just the basics and add AI later?
faq.q8.a: Yes. Many basic services — cameras, locks, networks — can be expanded later with any mode from the Predictive AI Platform, without redoing the original installation.
faq.q9.q: Do you also work with warehouses, industrial units or rural properties, or only homes?
faq.q9.a: Both. Warehouses & Properties has its own section in the menu, with basic services, AI Security at perimeter/industrial scale, and the AI Security Pack for Businesses.
faq.q10.q: How do I request a quote?
faq.q10.a: Via WhatsApp — it's the fastest and most direct way. The first technical visit is free with no obligation.
